features: Clear Digital Display: The display shows actual values and set values, allowing users to monitor rotation speed and heating bath temperature during operation.
Separate Dynamic Control Knobs: Two dedicated control knobs make the system easy to operate. Fast turning supports larger value changes, while slow turning allows precise adjustment.
Lock Function: The lock function helps prevent accidental changes to selected values during operation, supporting better repeatability and safer use.
LED Ring Light System: The intuitive LED ring light system makes activated functions clearly visible, even from a distance.
Flexible Flask Positioning: The system allows easy adjustment of the immersion depth up to 155 mm and the inclination angle from 20° to 80°.
Standby Function: The standby function stops active operations. In motor lift versions, the standby button also lifts the evaporating flask from the heating bath.
Residual Heat Warning: The system provides a residual heat warning when the heating bath temperature is above 50°C, helping improve laboratory safety.

sections.title: The rotary evaporation cycle
sections.description: How the Hei-VAP Core gently removes solvent in a continuous loop of rotate, heat, evaporate, condense and collect.

steps.title: Rotate
steps.description: The flask spins (10–280 rpm), spreading a thin film for a large surface area.

steps.title: Heat
steps.description: The water/oil bath (20–210 °C) gently warms the sample.

steps.title: Evaporate
steps.description: Under vacuum, solvent boils off at low temperature, protecting the product.

steps.title: Condense
steps.description: Vapour cools on the G3 condenser (0.22 m² surface) back to liquid.

steps.title: Collect
steps.description: Recovered solvent drains into the receiving flask; product stays behind.

The Heidolph Hei-VAP Expert Control Rotary Evaporator is designed for laboratories that need more control over evaporation, distillation, sample concentration, and solvent recovery. A 5-inch touch display controls the complete evaporation system, including vacuum and cooling temperature. Separate quick-access knobs allow direct control of rotation and vacuum, while the display gives users an overview of all key parameters and the current process. This page focuses on the Hei-VAP Expert Control Standard Handlift, P/N 573-02300-00, with handlift operation, G3 vertical glassware, and no coated condenser or receiving flask. sections.subheading: Integrated control of evaporation, vacuum, and cooling from one display
body: The Hei-VAP Expert Control from Heidolph is built for laboratories that need integrated control of rotary evaporation parameters from one operating interface.

Unlike standard rotary evaporator setups where vacuum and cooling may be managed separately, the Expert Control version brings evaporation system control into the 5-inch touch display, including vacuum and cooling temperature.

The display gives users a clear overview of values and the current process. Active functions are shown through pictograms, while quick-access knobs support direct control of rotation and vacuum without navigating through multiple menu layers.

The system supports two favorites on the start screen, an expandable solvent library, user-defined evaporation ramps, and automated evaporation through the Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program, also called DAA. These functions help laboratories improve process repeatability and reduce manual intervention during evaporation work.

As a Heidolph Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp supports laboratories with product consultation, configuration guidance, vacuum and cooling accessory selection, installation, user training, application support, and after-sales service.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAP Ultimate Control Rotary Evaporator?
faqs.answer: The Hei-VAP Ultimate Control is a Heidolph rotary evaporator designed for controlled solvent evaporation, vacuum distillation, sample concentration, and solvent recovery. It combines a 7-inch touch display, integrated vacuum and cooling temperature control, saved evaporation ramps, DAA automatic evaporation, and Lab 4.0-ready interfaces.

faqs.question: What is the exact Hei-VAP Ultimate Control model on this page?
faqs.answer: This page focuses on the Hei-VAP Ultimate Control hand lift model with G3 vertical glassware, P/N 575-02300-00. The confirmed configuration is handlift operation, G3 vertical glassware, and no coated condenser or receiving flask.

faqs.question: How is Hei-VAP Ultimate Control different from Hei-VAP Ultimate?
faqs.answer: Hei-VAP Ultimate Control adds integrated control of vacuum and cooling temperature from the 7-inch touch display. It also supports saved evaporation ramps, direct favorites, an expandable solvent library, and Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program for automatic evaporation.

faqs.question: How is Hei-VAP Ultimate Control different from Hei-VAP Expert Control?
faqs.answer: Both models support integrated vacuum and cooling temperature control, saved ramps, favorites, solvent library, and DAA. The main difference is that Hei-VAP Ultimate Control has a 7-inch touch display and USB, Micro SD, LAN, and RS 232 interfaces, making it Lab 4.0 ready.

faqs.question: What does the 7-inch touch display control?
faqs.answer: The 7-inch touch display controls the complete evaporation system, including rotation, vacuum, and cooling temperature. It also gives users an overview of all parameters and the current process.

faqs.question: Which quick-access knobs are available on Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: Hei-VAP Ultimate Control has separate quick-access knobs for vacuum and rotation. The right knob is used for direct vacuum control, and the left knob is used for rotation control.

faqs.question: What is Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program in Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program, also called DAA, supports automatic evaporation with customizable control. It helps users manage evaporation behaviour, including foam avoidance and efficient evaporation.

faqs.question: Can users save evaporation processes on Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: Yes. Users can define and save their own evaporation processes as ramps. This helps laboratories repeat controlled evaporation processes with better consistency.

faqs.question: Can favorite methods be transferred between devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Hei-VAP Ultimate Control supports transfer of individual favorites to other devices using a USB stick. This is useful when laboratories want to standardize commonly used evaporation settings across similar systems.

faqs.question: Which interfaces are available on Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: Hei-VAP Ultimate Control includes USB, Micro SD, LAN, and RS 232 interfaces. These interfaces support Lab 4.0-ready connectivity and connection with compatible external systems.

faqs.question: What is the speed range of Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: The Hei-VAP Ultimate Control supports a rotation speed range of 10 to 280 rpm. This allows controlled rotation for routine evaporation, solvent recovery, distillation, and sample concentration workflows.

faqs.question: What is the heating bath volume and temperature range?
faqs.answer: The heating bath volume is 6 L. The heating bath temperature range is 20 to 100 °C with water and 20 to 210 °C with oil.

faqs.question: What evaporation rates are listed for Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: The listed evaporation rates at a temperature difference of 40 °C are 8.5 L/h for toluene, 5.8 L/h for acetone, 3.5 L/h for ethanol, and 1.2 L/h for water. Actual performance depends on solvent type, vacuum level, cooling efficiency, glassware, sample volume, and operating conditions.

The final accessory set should be selected based on solvent, sample volume, cooling requirement, vacuum requirement, and workflow.

body: The Hei-VAP Ultimate Control from Heidolph is built for laboratories that need integrated control of rotary evaporation parameters with larger process visibility, automation support, and digital connectivity.

The 7-inch touch display controls the complete system, including vacuum and cooling temperature. It gives users an overview of all parameters and the current process, while pictograms on the display show active functions for clear monitoring.

Separate quick-access knobs support direct operation during active use. The right knob provides direct vacuum control, while the left knob supports rotation control. Users can set values either through the touch display or through the quick-access knobs.

The system supports two favorites on the start screen, an expandable solvent library, USB transfer of favorites, user-defined evaporation ramps, and automatic evaporation through the Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program, also called DAA.
With USB, Micro SD, LAN, and RS 232 interfaces, the Hei-VAP Ultimate Control supports Lab 4.0-ready connectivity for laboratories that need connection with compatible external systems.

As a Heidolph Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp supports laboratories with product consultation, configuration guidance, vacuum and cooling accessory selection, installation, user training, application support, genuine spares, and after-sales service.
